Cell.Text: [S] Don't you walk away from me!
[S] All right, hand over your valuables, or I'll gut you like a fish.
[S] Hail, Nightingale! Luck has shined down on me and made me a rich man. Here is your cut, as promised.
[S] Hail, brother! I saw you walking there and thought you might need this.
[S] Hail, sister! I saw you walking there and thought you could use this.
[S] G|Ha, what a coward. Didn't even put up a proper fight.

Node.Caption: WERJ02GiveMoney: Here, take it. Just leave me alone.

Cell.Text: [S] G|Then I guess that's your last request, fool!
[S] G|Well. I, uh, can see you're not one to be trifled with. Let this be a warning to you!
Nice try, but you don't scare me.
I'm not going to ask again.
Of course! I've seen you at the Flagon. My mistake.

Node.Caption: WERJ02PlayerThief: Whoa, brother. Don't you recognize a fellow Guild member?

Cell.Text: A Nightingale? Oh, I had no idea. My apologies.

Node.Caption: WERJ02Nightingale: I would think you'd have more respect for a Nightingale.

Cell.Text: [S] G|No, I guess not. Well, get out of here before I change my mind.
Yes, actually. You look like you're lousy with gold.

Node.Caption: WERJ02Persuade: Do I look like I have any money? (Persuade)
